---
title: Meeting assistants
description: Bind a Feishu app so a meeting assistant can join, collect the meeting, and report on an interval.
translation:
  source: en
  status: complete
  sourceVersion: "2026-11-18"
---

Open **Meeting assistants** (会议助手). Each assistant binds one Feishu app. Scan with Feishu to create or authorize a custom enterprise app. The confirmation page selects meeting join permission and event subscriptions. After binding, the platform submits an approval request to an administrator.

Configure the meeting topic and prompts first. Then generate and edit the agenda and the scenario phrasing. The assistant joins as that Feishu app, collects the meeting in real time, prepares reports on the interval you set, and can offer prompts during the meeting.

Binding the app does not create a meeting record. A record appears after the assistant is pulled into a Feishu meeting. Read it in [Meeting records](/build/meeting-records/).
